title: Data and code for: Channel-selective parity of the strain response in La2NiMnO6: a sign-blind majority gap and a displaced minority gap
description: Quantum ESPRESSO inputs and outputs, derived data files and analysis/plotting scripts for N. Paran, Computational Materials Science (accepted, 2026). The folder revision1/ contains the calculations added in the revision (Gamma-point phonons, elastic constants, band paths, a-a-a- tilt pattern). README.md maps every table and figure to its data file and script.
